title: Effects of the Intervention Clinical Forrest Therapy on Geriatric Patients
summary:
As part of the study ‘Clinical forest therapy in geriatrics’, clinical forest therapy units adapted to geriatric patients are being carried out. In order to shed light on the feasibility and safety of this therapy measure and to gain information on 
a change in the mood of the patients as a result of this measure, an accompanying study is being carried out on behalf of 
the Bavarian State Ministry of Health, Care and Prevention. For this purpose, patients will be asked about their current state of mind before and after the therapy.  The Current Mood Scale (ASTS) is used as a questionnaire, and patients are also asked how they liked the programme.
conditions: Improving the well-being of geriatric patients
